title: MSFS 2024: HUGE Marketplace Update! World Update 21 + Aerosoft Stuttgart vs Default
description:
The Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Marketplace just exploded with new content! From the skyscrapers of Australia in World Update 21 to the ultra-detailed Aerosoft Stuttgart, this week has something for every pilot.

In this video, we conduct a side-by-side comparison of the default MSFS 2024 scenery vs. new premium releases to see where the real improvements are. We also check out the massive VFR object fixes for Seattle and Vancouver, historical 1935 airfields from Redwing, and the new firefighting mission system.
